config.arm_variants: olat: classifier -> Linear(H, 3+K); z_O = logsumexp(z_O1..K) - log K in fp32; init = B0 head, O rows = B0 O row + N(0, std^2) perturbation centred over components (own Generator, seed init_seed+20000), biases copied; nli: after the B0 construction, deberta.* and pooler.* are overwritten from the pinned NLI checkpoint (B0 tokenizer, 4-class head and forward config kept); bibce: L = CE + lambda * 1/2 [BCE(m_AB, t_AB) + BCE(m_BA, t_BA)], m_AB = lse(z_E, z_F) - lse(z_B, z_O), m_BA = lse(z_E, z_B) - lse(z_F, z_O), targets E(1,1) F(1,0) B(0,1) O(0,0), fp32 outside autocast; all arm changes inside torch.random.fork_rng; dec / dec_h (v7): one directional score s(x, y), P(E)=ab, P(F)=a(1-b), P(B)=(1-a)b, P(O)=(1-a)(1-b) with a = sigmoid(s(A,B)), b = sigmoid(s(B,A)); loss BCE(s(A,B), 1[E or F]) fp32; dec = new Linear(H, 1); dec_h = NLI 3-way head, s = z_ent - lse(z_neu, z_con); predict: order entails iff s > 0
